text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Is it this way, I wonder? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? There's no one here... I could've 
sworn someone called for Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Could it be the Three Goddesses who called 
for Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, being remembered by the Three 
Goddesses is the fruit of all my PR work.
